reviewType: Read-only source and existing-test review; no tests or runtime probes were run
scope: Existing authorization, Staff-scope, and object-authorization test sources

routeMatrix.routerReview: All API route declarations are in backend/src/app.ts; no additional Express Router creation or router mount was found under backend/src.

verifiedBoundaries.evidence: Customer holds, orders, payment completion, and order reads are scoped to the authenticated user ID; customer-only routes also enforce the CUSTOMER role. The route matrix maps these controls to existing authorization regression tests.

Both ticket-ID and QR check-in resolve the linked ticket cinema and compare it with the current Staff assignment; unassigned or wrong-cinema Staff receives 403. Admin check-in remains global. Existing Staff-scope and authorization tests cover denials and side effects.

requireAuth reloads role, assignedCinemaId, and authVersion from the user record and rejects stale token versions. Mutating and check-in transactions revalidate/lock the current actor; existing tests cover role revocation and cinema reassignment behavior.

qrStatusBehavior.requirement: REQ-TICKET-03 requires 403 for Staff who are unassigned or assigned to a different cinema; Admin can check in at any cinema.
qrStatusBehavior.implementation: An unknown QR returns 404 TICKET_NOT_FOUND. A valid QR resolves to its ticket, then wrong-cinema Staff receives 403 CINEMA_FORBIDDEN.
qrStatusBehavior.assessment: Preserve the current distinction: SRS REQ-TICKET-03 requires 403 for unassigned or wrong-cinema Staff, while TC-SEC-26 and OpenAPI specify 404 for an unknown QR. The status difference can reveal whether a QR exists; this review did not perform exploitability testing.

result.summary: No P0/P1 BOLA or IDOR issue was identified within the reviewed owner, cinema, and authentication-version boundaries.

limitations: No tests, DAST, database access, Docker actions, or runtime requests were performed for this review; existing test sources were inspected only.
This focused review is not exhaustive ASVS or OWASP API Top 10 coverage and is not an adversarial BOLA/IDOR assessment.
The review does not establish behavior for every object, state, field, unlisted consumer, or production configuration.
